name: add_springboot_tasktracker_task_labels
description: Repo-scale: add a labels list to tasks (model + 3 DTOs + repository + service + 2 controllers), with a composable ?label= query param that must still apply alongside projectId/status/assigneeId
prompts: Add labels to tasks. Give Task a `labels` field: a List<String>, defaulting to an empty list. TaskCreateRequest and TaskUpdateRequest should accept an optional `labels` list - TaskCreateRequest defaults to an empty list when omitted, and TaskUpdateRequest REPLACES the full list when provided (leaves it unchanged when omitted, not merged). TaskResponse must return labels. Add an optional `label` query parameter to GET /tasks that returns only tasks whose labels contain that exact string - it must compose with the existing projectId/status/assigneeId filters (when several are given together, only tasks matching ALL of them come back, not just the label filter). Remember any other code that calls TaskService.listTasks will need its call site updated for the new parameter.
